name: Murder at the Dead Sea
overview: Ravi Shem Tov is a young and inexperienced police investigator in the Arad police department who, after contracting COVID-19, arrives at a hotel for COVID-19 evacuees on the Dead Sea. On her first night there, a mysterious and surprising death occurs and she is forced to embark on a journey to uncover the truth about which of the hotel's colorful guests is behind the murder.
